newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan seeks 270,000 T US/Australian wheat - agent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seeks 270,000 T US/Australian wheat - agent.

text.p: Pakistan issued separate tenders on Monday for 270,000 tonnes of U.S. Grade 2 or better soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat for delivery between January 8-31, its export agent said.

The Pakistani Ministry of Food and Agriculture invited bids to be opened at 1100 Pakistan Standard Time on December 22 and must remain valid until 1800 PST on December 23 for the supply of 270,000 tonnes U.S. Grade-2 or better soft white wheat in bulk plus/minus five percent buyer's option to be financed under the GSM 102 export credit guarantee program.

In a separate tender notice, it invited bids to be opened at the same time on December 22, for the supply of 270,000 tonnes of Australian white milling wheat in bulk plus/minus five percent buyer's option under Australian credit.
